subject: FinCore POC - access confirmation & kickoff recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fincore.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: POC plan & success criteria - FinCore (next steps)

Hi Alex -

Great to connect today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial:

1) Objective: Validate Redwood Inference for FinCore's fraud-detection scoring pipeline (batch and real-time) to assess latency, cost, and precision tradeoffs.
2) Success criteria (proposed):
   - Batch throughput: process 2M events/day end-to-end with no more than 10% increase in job runtime versus baseline
   - Real-time P95 latency <= 120ms for 512-token payloads
   - Embedding similarity quality: top-5 retrieved results match annotated set >= 88%
   - Unit cost per 1k tokens <= target we discussed (we can finalize once quantization profile chosen)
3) Evaluation plan: Redwood will provide a sandbox project and API keys; FinCore provides a representative sample dataset (~100k anonymized events) and a small labeled eval set for quality checks. We'll run a 2-week trial with weekly status updates.
4) Timeline (proposed):
   - This week: exchange access details + sample dataset (owner: FinCore)
   - Week of 6/22: kickoff & data ingest (Redwood SE + FinCore infra)
   - 6/23-6/30: run evaluation scenarios and measure metrics
   - 7/1: review results and discuss next steps
5) Owners:
   - Redwood: Marissa (PoC owner), Marcus (SE) - setup, evaluation, instrumentation
   - FinCore: Alex (product lead), Sara (platform) - dataset + access, acceptance criteria

Attachments: POC_scope_v1.pdf attached.

Asks: please confirm the success criteria above (or suggest edits), and confirm who will provide the anonymized sample dataset and the expected location (S3 bucket). Also confirm kickoff time on the week of 6/22.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: POC_scope_v1.pdf]
